text: Entry 913 initializes MimePgpeData.self to nullptr, and the accepted source retains that pointer default. The neighboring output_closure uses MimeClosure::zero because it is a tagged closure, while output_fn is a function pointer initialized to nullptr. MimePgpe_init assigns self, output_fn and output_closure before the proxy callback setup. Preserve the zero value appropriate to each field's type; do not mechanically replace all three with the same syntax. No encrypted message was processed.
